name: Foodlink F&B Holdings (India)
summary: Foodlink F&B Holdings runs events catering, banquets, casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens in India and the UAE, led by promoter Sanjay Manohar Vazirani. Revenue from operations grew from ₹377 cr in FY24 to ₹568 cr in FY26 and profit after tax roughly doubled to ₹29.1 cr in FY26, but the company lost ₹16.2 cr in the six months to September 2026. The ₹360.76 cr issue at ₹181–₹191 is ₹192 cr fresh plus a ₹168.76 cr offer for sale (about 47%), and promoter holding falls to 49.51%; the promoter's average cost is about ₹0.19 per share. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 40.9x and price to book about 2.9x, and the RHP names no listed peers to compare against; tax and criminal cases are pending against the promoter and directors.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹377.2 cr (FY24) to ₹567.5 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 22.7%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew in FY25 (₹450.9 cr, +19.5%) and FY26 (₹567.5 cr, +25.9%).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.10 at 30 Sep 2026 (borrowings ₹22.4 cr vs net worth ₹216.0 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings fell from ₹35.3 cr (FY24) to ₹24.3 cr (FY26) while revenue rose about 50%.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose from ₹79.6 cr (FY24) to ₹106.2 cr (FY25) and ₹229.4 cr (FY26), then dipped to ₹216.0 cr at Sep 2026.

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹29.9 cr in FY26, about 103% of the ₹29.1 cr profit.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew about 104% in FY26, from ₹14.3 cr to ₹29.1 cr, though the six months to Sep 2026 showed a ₹16.2 cr loss.

pr2.finding: PAT margin improved from -4.04% (FY24) to 3.13% (FY25) and 5.09% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 17.35% in FY26 (-7.25% for the six months to Sep 2026).

pr4.finding: ROCE was not found in public sources for the RHP figures.

pr5.finding: The RHP says no listed company in India or abroad has a comparable business model, so there is no peer median.

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E is about 40.9x (₹1,190.9 cr market cap ÷ ₹29.1 cr FY26 PAT), but the RHP names no listed peers to compare it with.

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book is about 2.9x (₹1,190.9 cr ÷ ₹408 cr = ₹216.0 cr Sep 2026 net worth + ₹192 cr fresh issue), but the RHP names no listed peers.

va3.finding: Post-issue market cap to sales is about 2.1x (₹1,190.9 cr ÷ ₹567.5 cr FY26 revenue), but the RHP names no listed peers.

va4.finding: The last reported share issue was a ₹99.75 cr placement at ₹363 per share in March–May 2025, over 12 months before the IPO; transfers in the last 12 months were not found.

pg1.finding: Promoter and promoter group holding falls from 63.40% to 49.51% after the issue.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transactions were ₹9.25 cr in FY26, about 1.6% of revenue.

pg4.finding: Three tax and statutory cases (₹1.33 cr) are pending against the promoter and four criminal cases (₹3.00 cr) against directors.

is1.finding: The OFS is ₹168.76 cr of the ₹360.76 cr issue, about 46.8%.

is2.finding: The ₹360.76 cr issue is about 30.3% of the ₹1,190.9 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: Promoter Sanjay Vazirani, who sells shares in the OFS, has an average cost of about ₹0.19 per share, far over 10x below the ₹191 upper band.

up1.finding: ₹113.7 cr (about 59% of the ₹192 cr fresh issue) goes to a centralised kitchen, two banquets and four new restaurants.

up2.finding: ₹21.0 cr, or about 11% of the fresh issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

up3.finding: General corporate purposes and issue expenses together take ₹57.29 cr (29.8% of the fresh issue); GCP alone is capped at 25% and not separately stated.

up4.finding: ₹21.0 cr repays borrowings of the company and its subsidiary FGRCS; whether any lender is a promoter entity was not found.

lg1.finding: Cases against the company total ₹15.48 cr (about 7% of net worth), and a tax show-cause notice alleges a further ₹23.32 cr (about 11%).

lg2.finding: Four criminal cases are pending against directors (₹3.00 cr) and one regulatory case against the company.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹4.51 cr at 30 Sep 2026, about 2% of net worth.

rk1.finding: The top-10 customer share was not found; the largest customer gave 18.75% of FY26 revenue.

rk2.finding: The top 10 suppliers made up 19.80% of material costs in the six months to Sep 2026.

rk3.finding: The company was incorporated in 2015, about 11 years ago; its predecessor business dates to 2003.

rk4.finding: Auditors reported qualifications relating to books of account, audit trails and CARO 2020; no qualification of the financial statements themselves is reported.
